project_type: Python Flask SPA - TikTok Downloader with AI Chat feature
build_system: pip with requirements.txt, deployed via Procfile/nixpacks
verification_instructions: 1. Run python -c 'import app' to verify no syntax errors. 2. Check that CSS/JS files are valid. 3. Verify the /ai route exists in app.py.
environment_constraints: No test suite exists. Validation is via import check and static analysis of HTML/CSS/JS.
contribution_requirements: Do not touch TikTok Downloader functionality. Do not change downloader endpoints. Keep sidebar/menu intact. Use specific CSS classes (ai-page, ai-chat-layout, makima-avatar) to avoid affecting other pages.
key_patterns: SPA architecture: single index.html template with view switching via JavaScript (navigateTo function in ui.js). Views are toggled by hiding/showing div containers (viewDownloader, viewMakimaAI, etc). CSS is split into multiple files (variables.css, base.css, layout.css, etc). The hero header with 'MII NETWORK' and 'TIKTOK DOWNLOADER' is in a <header class='header'> inside .page. The AI chat is rendered dynamically by renderMakimaAI() in makima-ai.js into #viewMakimaAI.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (Flask), templates/index.html (single template), static/css/ (8 CSS files), static/js/ (9 JS files), static/img/ (makima-ai-profile.png, owner.png)
